foot: Tee sets: Back (blue, 6,667, 72.8/134; the NCCGA played the blue tees here in 2015 and 2024), Eagle (gold, back, 6,920, 73.8/141) and Middle (white, 6,186, 70.8/130) are each fully solved from their own boxes; Forward (red, 5,174) moves the Back tee along the line. Card: golfify / OpenGolfAPI (Back 6,667). The NCCGA Blue tee sheets differ: Fall 2015 = this card except 10 at 420 (6,682); Fall 2024 as set up that day 6,512 (1 379, 2 144, 5 420, 7 461, 8 395, 9 485, 11 430, 14 246, 17 465, 18 417). The Nov 7-8 tee sheet is not posted: check each tee plaque and use Move this tee (5-yd steps) to match it. Calm-day picks: 256 prior draws per hole; the wind grids at the card tee are refined on 16,000 common swings per club. Clubs: Driver to Mid iron plus an 8-iron (162 carry, assumed ~12-yd gapping below the 210 long iron) for lay-ups. Trees are checked along the ball's flight through the measured 2015 lidar crowns (+1.5 m growth; mostly bare November crowns: stop chance from the path length through them) as well as where it finishes; a tee ball on a green is scored with putts (drivable 14). The map was checked on NAIP 2020 / 2022 and the 2015 3DEP lidar. Start time and starting hole are adjustable (default 9:00 shotgun on hole 1; the NCCGA lists 9:00 am both days, tee sheet not yet posted).

hole_notes.3: forced carry over the wooded ravine and the pond to a fairway that starts ~185 yds out (Back) and bends right toward the green; woods left all the way.
hole_notes.5: woods left beyond the cart path the whole way (grown in since the 2015 lidar); woods right 0-10 yds off the fairway.
hole_notes.9: unmown grass right beyond the cart path from ~280; trees right 150-280.
hole_notes.11: a strip of unmown grass left (175-305 from Back), trees right 220-285 beyond the cart path.
hole_notes.14: the pond crosses the line ~200-260 yds out in front of the green: lay up short of ~200 or carry ~265.
hole_notes.17: the creek runs down the left at 140-240 and then crosses diagonally 240-345 yds from Back between the two fairways; woods right.
hole_notes.18: house lots / OB 45-70 yds left; trees right 240-340 beyond the cart path.
hole_notes.2: trees left, right and long; open and short of the green. The blue box is the best aim for any pin on your iron pattern (expected strokes, OPTIMIZE.md section 13): 1-2 yds short of the green centre on the centre line, ~0.02 strokes better than the centre; long is the costly miss. From Back a full PW (138) is the club (GW comes up ~10 short).
hole_notes.12: fairway short of the green, trees long, a bunker right. Best aim for any pin: about 4 yds short of the green centre, ~0.04 strokes better than the centre or the old box; long is the costly miss. From Back: 7-iron (174).
hole_notes.6: water short, left and right; trees long. Aim at the centre (the box: centre to 1 yd short); every other spot costs. From Back: GW (126).
hole_notes.16: water right and short, trees left and long; the green tilts ~5 % back to front. Best aim for any pin: 1-2 yds short of the centre on the centre line (the old box, 2 yds long, cost ~0.07). From Back: 9-iron (150), also on Sunday.
